name: KARL STORZ
description: KARL STORZ SE & Co. KG is a medical device manufacturer founded in 1945 in Tuttlingen, Germany, producing rigid and flexible endoscopes, surgical instruments, and operating room integration systems (OR1 and CollaboratOR). In August 2024, KARL STORZ acquired [Asensus Surgical](/company/asensus_surgical), adding the Senhance and Luna laparoscopic platforms to its portfolio. KARL STORZ serves as an OEM visualization supplier for surgical robotics, including the 3D endoscopic vision system for the [Medtronic Hugo RAS](/robot/medtronic_hugo_ras), and maintains commercial partnerships with [Moon Surgical](/robot/moon_maestro) and Sovato. Karl Storz endoscopes were also paired with Computer Motion's [Zeus](/robot/computer_motion_zeus) robotic system.
